lookup_atomic_number_by_mass: lookup atomic numbers from atomic mass values using closest match within 0.1 tolerance

run_lammps_with_fairchem: run a LAMMPS molecular dynamics simulation using a FairChem MLIP predictor for force calculations
create_fix_external_callback: create a FixExternalCallback to compute MLIP forces and virial for LAMMPS external fix integration
